unit.why: A single narrative: a wandering preacher, neglected when R. Menahem Nahum of Chernobyl arrives at the same host's house, challenges the tsaddik and is answered with a homily that leaves him ashamed.

stories.start_quote: מהרב הצדיק ר׳ מנחם נחום מ טשארנאביל
stories.summary_en: A wandering preacher lodges with a rich, hospitable village Jew. When R. Nahum of Chernobyl arrives, the preacher is forgotten. Drunk and resentful, he quotes the Talmud's 'good guest' saying against the tsaddik, who reinterprets it: a guest's burden on his host reflects the guest's own sins, so he should repent. The preacher is left ashamed.
